Instapage REST API v1 for managing workspaces, landing pages, team members,
groups, collections, form submissions, assets, domains, personalizations,
experiments, and analytics. Authentication is via Bearer token.
Rate limits: 200 requests/minute per token and IP, with daily quotas based
on the plan.
